about: A Python library for downloading market data from Yahoo Finance.

prs.title: Market cap is right for London, Johannesburg and Tel Aviv stocks
prs.broken: The quick market cap for stocks priced in pence or cents, like Vodafone in London, came out 100 times too big.
prs.changed: The value now converts those prices to pounds, rand or shekels first, as the price history already did.
prs.matters: Screens and comparisons across markets use the real company size.
